context: A small ryokan dining room. Mei is travelling alone after a hard period; the elderly woman across from her (Sachiko, also alone) starts a conversation.
purpose: incidental healing — stranger-but-not, brief warmth between two solo travellers

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Soft, the wobble of older Tokyo speech. A small smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: A small startled politeness. Half-bow in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 私も。…たまには、一人もええもんですよ。
lines.en: Me too. …Now and then, alone is nice, you know.
lines.style: A small graceful line. Voice quiet.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: A small honest agreement. Eyes lift half a step.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 何かあって、来られたん？
lines.en: Did something happen, that you came here?
lines.style: A small careful question. No pressure.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: …A little. A few things, you know.
lines.style: A small honest answer. Doesn't volunteer.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。…元気になるまで、ゆっくりね。
lines.en: Mm. …Until you're well — take your time.
lines.style: A small grandmother's line. Real — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: …ありがとうございます。本当に、優しい。
lines.style: A small voice catching half a step.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いえいえ。お時間、しっかり休んで。
lines.style: A small bow inside the voice. Closes warmly.
